Name: The sailor scarecrows (NEW UPDATE FOR 1.5)

Description:
This is an updated Content Patcher version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/386]The sailor scarecrows (OFFICIAL UPDATE FOR 1.3)

If you have an interesting sprite, then I can add it to the mod.
